messages:
anna_cs: Kicking off Nimbus Labs Dedicated bring-up. Goal: allocate quota ~120k tpm, autoscale floor=2 nodes, burst up to 8. Need load-test schedule, SRE handoff, and a short customer enablement/demo during rollout. Renewal flagged (trial ends in 30d) — want a canary by Wed so we can de-risk renewal. @jin_eng @omar_se @leah_sre

omar_se: Ack — Wed 10-12 PST works for a canary window. Can you confirm expected QPS and token mix so we tune the generator?

anna_cs: Target steady QPS ~180. Latency target p95 < 120ms. Token profile: 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (64-512), 10% long. I'll put the prompt set in the shared doc. Also capture a 20-min feedback slot for the customer after first canary.

jin_eng: Adding a suggested autoscale policy I can push to staging: 
```yaml
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 8
cpu_target_percent: 65
scale_cooldown_seconds: 90
burst_override: true
```
I'll stage it and share the pipeline link. Will also include a prefix-caching priming step.

leah_sre: We'll run shadow load on staging first, then dark-launch to the prod subnet during canary. Need KMS access for enriched logs and traces — @anna_cs can you confirm tenant id so I can request temporary keys?

anna_cs: Tenant ID is nimbus-42. KMS access ticket CS-592 created and attached to the onboarding board. Also, we should capture feedback via a short Miro board during the Thursday enablement.

capacity-bot: load-test scheduled by jin_eng: start=2026-03-24T18:00:00Z, job_id=lt-8872, estimated_duration=3h. Status: queued.

omar_se: Canary traffic ramp plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 45 minutes. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% or p95 > 200ms for 5min window. Also track model-fallbacks and token drop rates.

anna_cs: Noted. If canary passes we'll surface perf + cost delta to the renewal owner; passing should reduce renewal risk to green. Leah — can you coordinate on-call rotations for the canary window?

leah_sre: I'm on-call for the window. I'll watch traces, queue depth, evictions, and OOMs. Will post alerts to #incidents if thresholds hit.

simon_prod: Quick ops tip — run prefix cache priming before first traffic jump to avoid cold-start p95 spikes. Also capture kernel selection logs in the first 30 minutes.

anna_cs: Good call. Jin, can you add the priming script to the load job?

jin_eng: Done. Added priming: `python tools/prime_cache.py --tenant nimbus-42 --keys 20k` as a pre-step in lt-8872. I also attached the prompt mix file to the job.

anna_cs: Thanks all. I'll update the customer touchpoint doc after the first canary and run the feedback session Thurs 11am. Will log any renewal notes in the account health playbook. :rocket:
